arguments.sql: SELECT u.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions, grouped by the gender of the user who owns the card, for male and female users.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, since the question asks for transaction counts and not fraud rates.
A transaction belongs to the user who owns its card (transactions -> cards -> users).
